shorts_extract.hook: Patrick Wall buzzes thick touch nerves on his own arm at MIT to prove a spinal 'gate' can block pain before it reaches the brain.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Melzack & Wall's 1965 Science model: fast A-beta touch fibers vs slow C pain fibers in the dorsal horn + top-down descending control.
shorts_extract.twist: How the 1965 paper invented TENS in 24 months, solved phantom-surgery failures, and overturned 300 years of Descartes.
